full_name: Naomi Ko | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Medicine Mary Beth and Chris Gordon Fellow New York University
bio: Naomi Ko is an academic medical oncologist specializing in both the treatment of breast cancer and the study of cancer disparities. At Radcliffe, she will write a book chronicling her experience taking care of women for whom a breast cancer diagnosis is not their biggest problem.
